title: debugging with the rubber duck
caption:
a full session transcript with my most senior engineer.

I explain the function. the duck says nothing.
I explain the check. the duck says nothing.
halfway through the next sentence: oh. OH.

do you have a rubber duck, or do you explain it to a person?

items: ok so the function takes the user id…
then it checks if that user exists
and if they don't, it returns— wait.
slide.kicker: the duck bills by the hour
